data.one_liner: Middleware that blocks non-HTTPS requests to a Shelf or Dart Frog server.
data.what_it_does: It intercepts incoming requests and rejects any that are not over HTTPS, optionally returning a custom error response. The middleware can be added to a Shelf pipeline or wrapped for Dart Frog usage.
use_when: You need to enforce HTTPS on a Shelf or Dart Frog API
Your server is exposed directly to the internet and you want to reject HTTP traffic
You want a quick, declarative way to add SSL enforcement without custom routing logic
avoid_when: Your traffic is already terminated at a reverse proxy that guarantees HTTPS
You are using a framework that already provides SSL enforcement
strengths: Simple to add to existing Shelf pipelines
No build_runner or code generation required
weaknesses: Only works with Shelf or Dart Frog
Does not handle HTTPS termination at load balancers
No support for other server frameworks
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec, import, and add enforceSSL() to your Pipeline or Dart Frog handler.
